Record<string, Omit<OAuthClient, \"id\">.description: Construct a type with a set of properties K of type T

clients$[key: string]#2.description: Construct a type with the properties of T except for those in type K.

defaultResource.description:
Resource the tokens are bound to when the request names none (RFC 8707): the absolute URI of a registered
protected resource

defaultScope.description: Scope when the request has none

metadataDocument.description: Loaded from a Client ID Metadata Document

redirect_uris.description: Allowed redirect URIs; loopback http URIs match any port

resources.description:
Other protected resources (absolute URIs, RFC 8707 §2.2) every grant of the client may mint access tokens for,
besides the one it is bound to: a refresh or code exchange naming one gets a token with that audience from the
same refresh-token family. Registered protected resources only, never a resource of another application

accessTtl.description: Access token lifetime (s); defaults to TokenService

clientMetadataDocuments.description: Whether client metadata documents is enabled

clients.description: Static clients by id; `null` removes a built-in client

consentUrl.description: Consent UI; defaults to the built-in page

deviceUrl.description: Device code entry UI; defaults to the built-in page

issuer.description:
Issuer; defaults to the request origin. When set, the access tokens carry it as `iss` with the RFC 9068
`at+jwt` type, so another application can verify them (see `resources`)

refreshTtl.description: Refresh token lifetime (s); defaults to TokenService

registration.description: Dynamic client registration (RFC 7591); defaults to `open` when a protected resource is registered, else `off`

registrationIdleTtl.description: Lifetime of a registered client since its last use (s)

registrationRateLimit.description: Registrations allowed per client IP in the window

registrationRateWindow.description: Window of the registration rate limit (s)

registrationRedirectPatterns.description: Globs every redirect URI of a registration must match one of

registrationUnusedTtl.description: Lifetime of a registered client never used (s)

resources.description:
Protected resources served by other applications (absolute URIs, RFC 8707): accepted as a `resource` or a client
`defaultResource`, never chosen by default. Their tokens are verified from the issuer keys, so they require
`issuer`, an asymmetric `CryptoService` algorithm and its published JWKS (`url`)

resultUrl.description: Result UI; defaults to the built-in page

scopesSupported.description: Advertised scopes; defaults to the top-level operation groups

MfaVerification.description: Verification of one MFA operation on one owner, with its original timestamp.
